name: Breaker
tagline: Bigger type where there is room, a sidebar that reaches your library, and navigation that stops filling in behind itself.

highlights.title: The Library V3 sidebar, rebuilt
highlights.body: Home sits above Your Library as fixed chrome, so filters and search never hide it. The search field is inline when the pane has room and collapses to a magnifier that morphs open in place when it does not — one Escape clears, a second closes, and it is never remembered across launches. Filter pills keep their width when selected, a round ✕ clears everything, and the fused qualifier pill is legible on any accent. Every row, glyph and chip now shares one left edge.

media.alt: The Library V3 sidebar: Home above Your Library, an inline search field beside the Recents pill, filter pills, and Liked Songs and playlists sharing one left edge

highlights.title: Recents means recently played
highlights.body: In the sidebar and in Your Library, "Recents" now follows what you listened to — including plays from your other devices, through your listening history. Opening a playlist no longer moves it to the top; playing one does, and everything you have not played keeps its added-date order below.

media.alt: The sidebar sorted by Recents with the sort pill open, showing Recents, Recently added, Alphabetical and Creator

highlights.title: A compact, instant album drawer
highlights.body: On an artist page the album drawer opens in one 200 ms motion under the cover you clicked, with a caret pointing at it, compact rows, two columns on a wide window and a Show all row past the first dozen tracks — no skeleton flash for an album you already opened, and no drawer hopping between rows while the page scrolls.

media.alt: An artist page's discography with the album drawer open under a cover: a caret at the cover, compact track rows in two columns
